prompt: Implement `run_failure_percentage_ejection(addresses, config, randint)` in `outlier/detection.py`: one pass of the failure percentage algorithm of xDS outlier detection, as gRFC A50 specifies it. decision: A50 said the percentage limit stopped ejection only once reached, and that at least one address is ejected regardless of the value. Now ejection never takes the ejected percentage above the limit, so 0 disables it.
